text:
Zoe (CSM): FYI — Tidewell dedicated pool bring-up scheduled for TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Need final quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a concrete load test window. Can folks confirm readiness?
Marcus (SRE): I'm on it. Infra completed provisioning this morning. Pool is 6xA10G-slices by default, can bump to 8 if we expect warm start traffic.
Anya (Onboarding): Customer onboarding checklist mostly green. They requested KMS integration and network ACL review — both approved. Renewal conversation scheduled after go-live (they're flagged medium risk until latency stabilizes).
Ravi (EngInfra): Quick note — autoscale policy defaults to scale_up at 70% GPU util over 60s and scale_down at 30% over 5m. For Tidewell's short bursts we might want a higher burst buffer and shorter scale_up to avoid throttled responses.
Kira (Solutions): Proposed autoscale tweak: scale_up: 60% util with cooldown 45s, burst reserve +2 nodes, pre-warm caches for the first 2 minutes. Also plan a fallback to quant-8 model if queue depth > 75. Thoughts?
Marcus (SRE): Agree on pre-warm. Also set request queue threshold on router at 40 to trigger burst. We should add a soft cap per-customer token rate so a single spike doesn't starve others.
Zoe (CSM): Customer expects 200 qps peak and sustained 30 qps. If we meet those numbers reliably they'll sign the renewal addendum. Anya — capture that in the success criteria.
Anya (Onboarding): Captured in the doc: "SLA targets: p95 < 450ms for short gen, throughput 200 qps peak, token cost within estimated band." I'll add sign-off items for KMS and network.
Kira (Solutions): I'll run the shadow load test tomorrow 09:15 PT for 30m. Script below — will run against staging pool and then shadow to the reserved pool:
```bash
# ramp: 5m warmup, 20m steady, 5m cooldown
hey -n 360000 -c 200 -q 0.2 "https://staging.redwood.example/v1/generate" \ \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -m POST -d '{"model":"tidewell-prod-v1","input":"short prompt"}'
```
Kira (Solutions): Will post metrics and a short runbook in the console channel.
Marcus (SRE): deploy-bot just reported capacity provisioning completed. deploy-bot: pool.tidewell-reserved status=READY nodes=6 zone=us-west-2a. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: autoscaler.policy="util-60s" current_reserve=0 burst_buffer=2
Zoe (CSM): Great. Couple of coordination items: 1) Can someone join customer call at 10:30 PT for quick debrief? 2) Capture any odd regressions and tag them as "renewal-risk" if they impact response time >3x expected.
Marcus (SRE): I'll join 10:30. Also will set a short alert: p95 latency > 1.5s for 3 consecutive minutes -> page oncall.
Ravi (EngInfra): We'll enable KV prefix caching for the first 100 tokens to reduce repeated prefix cost during the test. Adding quantized fallback to the router mapping as Kira suggested.
Anya (Onboarding): Postmortem template link for test failures: https://redwood.docs/internal/onboard/postmortem-template. I'll collect feedback and feed into the renewal health checklist.
Kira (Solutions): After tests, will capture: observed p50/p95/p99, token cost delta vs estimate, model output drift notes (qualitative), and any FMs on model fallback.
Zoe (CSM): Perfect. Last ask — can marketing/advocate team get a short blurb if go-live looks clean? They want a customer quote for the case study if renewal goes green. :slightly_smiling_face:
Marcus (SRE): Running final smoke now. Will update in this thread in ~10m with the run results.
Kira (Solutions): Copy — will push test artifacts to https://console.redwood.example/projects/tidewell/tests/1708888000
Marcus (SRE): Smoke done — basic inference okay, latency ~380ms p95 for short gen. Starting scheduled load test now.
Kira (Solutions): First 5m ramp looks healthy, queues < 10, autoscaler hasn't spun up extra nodes yet (expected).
Marcus (SRE): At minute 12 we saw queue jump to 48, autoscaler added 2 nodes, p95 back to ~430ms. No errors.
Anya (Onboarding): Customer on call reports initial requests feel snappy. They're watching billing estimate but happier about latency.
Zoe (CSM): Awesome. I'll convert this into the renewal status update and mark as "go-live: success (monitoring)" unless we see regression in the next 24h. Thanks everyone. :tada:
